title: Entity catalog table
responsibility: Lists config variables with compact source values and full-value inspection, and remaining nonvisual entities with their category columns.

inputs.name: ExplorerTable.category
inputs.description: Required category other than pages and components: shells, functions, configs, services or models. Determines columns and labels; only a shell is described under its name.

inputs.name: ExplorerTable.rows
inputs.description: Required catalog rows in display order. Config rows contain variable names and committed source values; long values have compact previews and full-value inspection.

inputs.name: ExplorerTable.nav
inputs.description: Required navigation context for entity links and actions.

inputs.name: ExplorerTable.verification
inputs.description: Defaults to true for module catalogs. Configs always show only Variable and Value columns; relationship tabs omit verification indicators.

inputs.name: ExplorerTable.lens
inputs.description: Revision-scoped screenshot evidence for linked consumers.

outputs.name: ExplorerTable
outputs.description: A Variable/Value table with compact previews and read-only full-value dialogs for long config expressions. Other categories retain their columns. Links preserve the selected revision.
